criteria.requirement: Add constraint.optimization.optimize(problem,objective,direction="min",max_solutions=None) and immutable OptimizationResult(solution,score,examined,complete,reason). Enumerate actual feasible solutions through the selected solver iterator, preserve input-order first tie, snapshot assignments before objective/history and validate finite non-bool numeric scores. Full exhaustion proves optimal/unsatisfiable; reaching a strict nonnegative evaluation budget reports incomplete budget even when total may equal that boundary, without lookahead or false optimality. max_solutions=0 does not start iteration. Always close supported iterators on return/error; unsupported solver iteration remains an explicit capability error, never secretly materialize all solutions. Reuse earlier repeat-string and independent declared-domain behavior so running different objectives never mutates the model.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
